author: DonaldMyTrump
body: Greetings avicus staff members. My name is YouCantCMe/Zac. I received an unfair ban on TeamSpeak. ParaSpider wrote this on my most recent appeal "The ban is justified, simple as that." I believe this is a disregard to his duty to the community to justify his bans with reasoning. He and several other senior mods have avoided confronting my points on why the ban is unjust in a biased effort to keep me banned. I would like the staff team to carefully read over my previous appeals and come up with an intelligent and well thought out reason that justifies this ban. Thanks for your time.
